name: BookingKoala
description_en:
BookingKoala is a service-business platform combining configurable booking forms, pricing rules, provider/team scheduling, customer accounts and a website builder. It also offers hiring, campaigns and operational tools on higher tiers. It is broader than a personal appointment link.

A realistic implementation starts with how the business prices and delivers a job. Provider count, storage and campaign contacts affect the subscription, so a displayed starting price is not the total for every service operation.
description_zh:
BookingKoala 是服务业务平台，结合可配置预约表单、价格规则、服务人员／团队排程、客户账户和网站构建器，高档还提供招聘、营销活动与运营工具。它的范围超出个人预约链接。

实际实施应从业务如何定价与交付一次服务开始。服务人员数、存储与营销联系人影响订阅，因此展示起价不是所有业务的总费用。

core_features.explanation_en: Match booking forms to pricing model, locations, frequency and extras.
core_features.explanation_zh: 让预约表单匹配计价方式、地点、频率与附加项。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure schedules, accounts and office roles around service jobs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 围绕服务任务配置排程、账户与办公室角色。

core_features.explanation_en: Use the generated site or embed booking forms on an existing website.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用生成的网站，或把预约表单嵌入现有网站。

en: Price and schedule a service job with provider/customer follow-up.
zh: 为服务任务定价、排程并跟进人员／客户。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor-hosted service-business store with generated website or embedded forms.
Deployment.zh: 厂商托管服务业务店面，提供生成网站或嵌入表单。

steps.en: Set store options and choose the form type for the service pricing model.
steps.zh: 设置商店选项，选择符合服务计价方式的表单类型。

steps.en: Configure locations, scheduling, notifications and providers before publishing.
steps.zh: 发布前配置地点、排程、通知及服务人员。

steps.en: Test a booking/change and inspect payment/provider records; confirm capacity and trial terms.
steps.zh: 测试预约／修改并检查付款与人员记录，确认容量及试用条款。

items.en: Onboarding links troubleshooting for missing dates, non-working forms and notifications, and documents provider setup/import tools. Start with a small sample and inspect the form, authoritative booking, provider schedule and payment state separately. The plan comparison documents booking export; preserve a representative export before migration. A failed charge or notification should be diagnosed before recreating the job to avoid duplication. This is operating advice, not a recovery guarantee. No deployment, data migration, payment/refund, export fidelity or open-source/self-hosted distribution was tested/verified.
items.zh: 入门文档链接了日期缺失、表单故障与通知问题的排障，并说明人员设置／导入工具。应从小样例开始，分别检查表单、权威预约、人员排程与付款状态。套餐对照列有预约导出，迁移前应保存代表性导出。扣款或通知失败时，建议先诊断再重建服务任务，避免重复。这是运营建议，不是恢复保证。未测试／核实部署、数据迁移、支付／退款、导出保真度或开源／自行托管发行版。

pricing.billing_basis: Tier based on providers/storage and campaign contacts; add-ons and tax require checks.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Starter from $27/month (5 providers/5GB), Growing $57 (15/15GB), Premium $197 (50/50GB and 5,000 contacts). Trial text conflicts 14/30 days; FAQ states billing after 14.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Starter 起价每月 27 美元（五人员／5GB），Growing 57（15／15GB），Premium 197（50／50GB 和 5,000 联系人）。试用文字有 14／30 天冲突，FAQ 说明 14 天后收费。

sections.title_en: Configure how a job is priced and staffed
sections.title_zh: 配置一次服务的定价与人员
sections.en: For an illustrative home-cleaning business, choose the form type matching the pricing model, configure service areas, frequency and extras, then set provider/team availability and payment rules. The official onboarding guide orders store options, forms/industries, smart scheduling, notifications, providers and website setup. A provider is a person performing the service; team members count individually. Test an unavailable provider, an out-of-area address and an extra-priced service before opening the form to customers.
sections.zh: 例如家庭清洁业务可选择符合计价方式的表单，配置服务区域、频率及附加项，再设置服务人员／团队可用时间与付款规则。官方入门指南按商店选项、表单／行业、智能排程、通知、人员和网站设置排序。Provider 指实际提供服务的人，团队成员逐人计数。开放客户表单前，应测试人员不可用、地址超区及含附加费服务。

sections.en: Forms can run on a generated BookingKoala site or be embedded in an existing website. Customer dashboards, provider accounts and office/admin subaccounts expose different tasks. Notifications need email verification and SMS setup in the onboarding guide; a form submission does not prove a reminder reached the provider. Higher-tier campaigns, hiring and multilingual options should be evaluated separately from the core booking loop. Website customisation and marketing features are not evidence of SEO or revenue improvements.
sections.zh: 表单可放在自动生成的 BookingKoala 网站，或嵌入已有网站。客户看板、服务人员账户和办公室／管理员子账户承担不同任务。入门指南要求验证邮件通知并配置短信；表单提交不证明提醒已到达服务人员。高档营销活动、招聘和多语言选项应与核心预约环分别评估。网站定制和营销功能不能证明 SEO 或收入提升。

sections.title_en: Providers, storage and contacts drive tiers
sections.title_zh: 人员、存储与联系人推动档位
sections.en: USD starting amounts are Starter $27/month for five providers or 5 GB, Growing $57 for 15/15 GB, and Premium $197 for 50/50 GB plus 5,000 campaign contacts. Larger tiers increase with providers, storage or contacts. The FAQ says hitting a limit keeps the store active but requires a manual upgrade to add affected capacity; it does not silently upgrade the account. Taxes are excluded. Pricing has mixed 14/30-day trial text, while the FAQ states billing after 14 days; confirm signup before entering payment details. No perpetual free plan was established.
sections.zh: 美元起价为 Starter 每月 27，五人员或 5 GB；Growing 57，15 人员／15 GB；Premium 197，50 人员／50 GB，另含 5,000 营销联系人。更高档随人员、存储或联系人增加。FAQ 说明达到上限后商店仍运行，但增加受限容量需人工升级，不会静默升级账户。价格未税。定价处同时出现 14／30 天试用，而 FAQ 写 14 天后收费，输入付款信息前应确认注册条件。未确认永久免费套餐。

research_gaps.en: Trial-duration discrepancy, payment/refund and SMS costs, live dispatch, account permissions, export/recovery and migration fidelity remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 试用时长差异、支付／退款与短信费用、真实派工、账户权限、导出／恢复和迁移保真度尚未核实。
